نهتدي (form VIII)
# نَهْتَدِي (nahtadī) /nah.ta.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
# نَهْتَدِيَ (nahtadiya) /nah.ta.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
